recalls.summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2016 Sedona and Sorento vehicles.  The vehicles may have been manufactured with faulty automatic transmission shift lever assembly components, preventing the shift lever from locking, which can allow the vehicle to rollaway.
